m2_definition.definition: A source-attested current national China Post six-digit routing-assignment edition with typed assignment objects, exact technical jurisdiction, stable identities, validity and exceptions; independently licensed point or area geometry with explicit assignment relations, reviewed CRS and topology; separate standard-address and civic/building-link review; exact source and terms SHA-256, reproducible transformations and coverage validation, approved immutable published artifacts and real AGID descriptor/loader/API verification. Outlet locations, formatting examples, a universal delivery address code, map access, synthetic tests or a directory total cannot satisfy this criterion.

definition_review.basis: The CN manifest had no named M2 target. The existing China runtime promotion paragraph explicitly requires current typed assignments, independently licensed point/area geometry, CRS/topology, standard-address/building-link review, privacy, rights, jurisdiction and provenance. Those country-specific requirements are retained, not replaced by an assignment-only target.
definition_review.geometry_absence_rule: Keep geometry none and M2 unmet when this target's geometric relation is absent. Never manufacture an official boundary to satisfy the target. Any derived/virtual layer must remain separately labelled and cannot masquerade as an official assignment relation.
definition_review.building_display_rule: A review is required; actual house numbers/buildings remain absent unless independently sourced explicit civic/building relations are licensed and verified.

locator_probe.purpose: Bounded read-only unfiltered public outlet lookup, matching the visible page's request. Two pages plus one first-page repeat, not nationwide harvesting or personal/customer search.
locator_probe.grain: A displayed postal service outlet row, not a postal-region, delivery-address or building record. No stable outlet ID or assignment edition was observed.

rights_review.postal_basis: The reviewed public outlet page and successful unauthenticated responses do not establish permission to retain, transform or redistribute a complete assignment/geometry dataset. The operator portal carries a copyright notice; no exact source/output reuse grant was established. This is an unresolved grant, not a legal conclusion that all postal facts are prohibited.
rights_review.spb_basis: A dynamically maintained GIS and sharing with UPU members, described in the 2025 reply, do not establish a public endpoint, open licence or current downloadable national edition.
rights_review.geometry_basis: NGCC's 2021 news report describes free online services and periodic updates, not a licence for a particular reusable postal geometry, address or building dataset. Tianditu documentation access failures are environment observations, not proof of global unavailability.
rights_review.authority_gates: No login, API key request, CAPTCHA bypass, private address/owner/land-title query, paid product, agreement, new repository/public destination or deployment without explicit approval. CN/HK/MO/TW identities remain technically separate.
